paragraphs.source_en: “It is not only Suneemon. Whoever speaks of abandoning the castle insults me, Kuhachiro, and I will never permit it!”

units.source_en: “It is not only Suneemon. Whoever speaks of abandoning the castle insults me, Kuhachiro, and I will never permit it!”
units.source_zh: “不仅是强右卫门一人，不管是谁，只要说放弃城池，那就是对我九八郎的侮辱，我决不允许！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不仅是强右卫门一人，不管是谁，只要说放弃城池，那就是对我九八郎的侮辱，我决不允许！”

paragraphs.source_en: At this, Jizaemon hurriedly stepped forward and said, “I understand, my lord. I, Jizaemon, will go!”

units.source_en: At this, Jizaemon hurriedly stepped forward and said, “I understand, my lord.
units.source_zh: 这时，次左卫门慌忙向前一步道：“明白了，大人。

units.source_en: I, Jizaemon, will go!”
units.source_zh: 次左卫门愿意前往！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 这时，次左卫门慌忙向前一步道：“明白了，大人。次左卫门愿意前往！”

units.source_en: “No!”
Suneemon cried. “I, Suneemon, will go!”
units.source_zh: 强右卫门大喊道，“强右卫门愿意前往！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不！”强右卫门大喊道，“强右卫门愿意前往！”

units.source_en: “As you command!”
units.source_zh: “遵命！”

units.source_en: Suneemon replied resolutely.
units.source_zh: 强右卫门毅然答道。

paragraphs.source_en: It was agreed that once Suneemon had safely broken through the enemy cordon, he would light a signal fire on Mount Ganpo. Then he departed from the main camp.

units.source_en: It was agreed that once Suneemon had safely broken through the enemy cordon, he would light a signal fire on Mount Ganpo.
units.source_zh: 大家商定，强右卫门安全突破敌人的警戒线后，一定要在雁峰山上点燃烟火报信。

units.source_en: Then he departed from the main camp.
units.source_zh: 然后，他就离开了大营。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大家商定，强右卫门安全突破敌人的警戒线后，一定要在雁峰山上点燃烟火报信。然后，他就离开了大营。

paragraphs.source_en: On the night of the fourteenth, a brilliant moon hung in the sky, casting every shadow on the ground in sharp relief.

units.source_en: On the night of the fourteenth, a brilliant moon hung in the sky, casting every shadow on the ground in sharp relief.
units.source_zh: 十四日晚上，皓月当空，地上的人影格外清晰。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十四日晚上，皓月当空，地上的人影格外清晰。

paragraphs.source_en: “If only there were no moon.” Suneemon muttered to himself as he hurried on. He passed through the outer defenses at Noushi and stopped in the shade of a tree beside the Ono River.

units.source_en: “If only there were no moon.”

ja.t: ていなければよいのだが」

units.source_zh: “要是没有月亮就好了。”

units.source_en: Suneemon muttered to himself as he hurried on.
units.source_zh: 强右卫门一边自言自语，一边赶路。

units.source_en: He passed through the outer defenses at Noushi and stopped in the shade of a tree beside the Ono River.
units.source_zh: 他穿过野牛护城，在大野川一棵树的树荫下站住。

paragraphs.source_zh: “要是没有月亮就好了。”强右卫门一边自言自语，一边赶路。他穿过野牛护城，在大野川一棵树的树荫下站住。

paragraphs.source_en: Then he removed the quiver he carried and wrote a poem upon his hand towel:

units.source_zh: 然后，他摘下随身携带的箭筒，在手巾上写了一首诗：

paragraphs.source_zh: 然后，他摘下随身携带的箭筒，在手巾上写了一首诗：

paragraphs.source_en: My lord is caught in direst straits,

units.source_en: My lord is caught in direst straits,
units.source_zh: > 我主水深火热中，

paragraphs.source_en: With jade pendant by my side, I go to summon aid.

units.source_en: With jade pendant by my side, I go to summon aid.
units.source_zh: > 玉坠陪我搬救兵。

paragraphs.source_en: Many perils lie upon the road ahead,

units.source_en: Many perils lie upon the road ahead,
units.source_zh: > 此去路上多艰险，

paragraphs.source_en: Yet all my fervent blood is pledged to loyalty.

units.source_en: Yet all my fervent blood is pledged to loyalty.
units.source_zh: > 一腔热血为尽忠。

paragraphs.source_en: He did not know how long he had slept. When he opened his eyes, the campfire opposite had already gone out, and the moon had slipped behind the clouds. Suneemon rose and hastily wrapped his long and short swords in his clothes, then hoisted everything onto his shoulders. Then, reconsidering, he cast both swords to the ground and took only his clothes and dagger.

units.source_en: He did not know how long he had slept.
units.source_zh: 不知睡了多久。

units.source_en: When he opened his eyes, the campfire opposite had already gone out, and the moon had slipped behind the clouds.
units.source_zh: 当他睁开眼睛的时候，对面的篝火已经熄灭，月亮已钻进了云彩。

units.source_en: Suneemon rose and hastily wrapped his long and short swords in his clothes, then hoisted everything onto his shoulders.
units.source_zh: 强右卫门站起来，急急忙忙地把长刀和短刀包到衣服里，把所有东西都背在肩上。

units.source_en: Then, reconsidering, he cast both swords to the ground and took only his clothes and dagger.
units.source_zh: 他转念一想，又把长短刀扔到地上，只带了衣服和匕首。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不知睡了多久。当他睁开眼睛的时候，对面的篝火已经熄灭，月亮已钻进了云彩。强右卫门站起来，急急忙忙地把长刀和短刀包到衣服里，把所有东西都背在肩上。他转念一想，又把长短刀扔到地上，只带了衣服和匕首。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, I shall return before long.” Suneemon bowed toward the main castle and vanished into the night.

units.source_en: “My lord, I shall return before long.”
units.source_zh: “大人，我去去就来。”

units.source_en: Suneemon bowed toward the main castle and vanished into the night.
units.source_zh: 强右卫门朝本城的方向拜了一拜，消失在夜色中。

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人，我去去就来。”强右卫门朝本城的方向拜了一拜，消失在夜色中。
